fact-seed-tavern.statement: The Crooked Lantern is a tavern.

fact-mara.statement: Mara Blackkeg operates the Crooked Lantern.

fact-opening.statement: Rain is falling outside the Crooked Lantern; a metallic knock was heard beneath its floor.

fact-job.statement: Mara offers the travelers supper and beds if they investigate the cellar bell.

rumor-empty-cellar.statement: Mara says nobody is in the cellar.

fact-cellar-access.statement: Mara permits the travelers to investigate the cellar and provides a lamp at its entrance.

fact-stairs.statement: Steep wooden stairs lead into a cellar; a bell wire follows the wall and water is visible below.

fact-signal.statement: The cellar bell wire is being pulled from below in a repeating group of three.

fact-mara-admission.statement: Mara retracts her certainty that the cellar is empty and says she hoped it was empty by now.

belief-arlen-mara.statement: Arlen judges that Mara is worried about a person below, rather than merely about the bell.

secret-shelter.statement: Mara allowed a traveler to rest in the cellar earlier tonight.

fact-voice.statement: A person below the tavern warns visitors not to move a rack from their side.

fact-shelter-admitted.statement: Mara tells the party she allowed a traveler to sleep in the cellar and thought he had left.

fact-trapped.statement: A traveler's hand is trapped beneath a fallen cellar rack; he can reach the bell wire.

fact-flood.statement: Ankle-deep water covers the cellar floor and flows inward through a drainage grate.

fact-rescue.statement: Elara frees the trapped traveler's bruised hand from the rack.

fact-iven-name.statement: The rescued traveler introduces himself as Iven.

rumor-rack-cause.statement: Iven says the rack shifted while he was trying to clear the drain.

fact-satchel.statement: A leather satchel is caught under the cellar drainage grate.

fact-shutoff.statement: A raised shutoff board above the drainage opening can stop the incoming water before the grate is opened.

rumor-wage-receipts.statement: Iven says the satchel contains repair-wage receipts, including one bearing his absent brother's name from last week.

fact-drain-ledge.statement: A narrow stone ledge runs from the cellar landing toward the drain, with a slick final stretch.

fact-board-jammed.statement: The shutoff board jams halfway down; water still enters and the cellar waterline continues to rise.

fact-handle-broken.statement: The shutoff board's handle breaks during the coordinated attempt; the board remains jammed and flooding continues.

fact-paper-threat.statement: Water has opened the satchel flap and is beginning to wash out its papers.

fact-evidence-lost.statement: Arlen's retrieval attempt fails: the satchel strap breaks, and the bag and papers wash beyond reach through the drain.

fact-safe-return.statement: Arlen, Elara, Torren and Iven return safely to the tavern; Mara blocks access to the flooded cellar.

fact-reward.statement: Mara honors the offer of supper and beds after the investigation and rescue.

rumor-hiding.statement: Mara says Iven requested a concealed place to rest because of papers he was carrying; Iven confirms the request.

rumor-dain.statement: Iven says his brother is Dain, has been absent for a month, and was named on a wage receipt dated seven days ago.

rumor-north-sluice.statement: Iven remembers the heading North Sluice Repairs on the lost receipt, but did not witness who collected or signed for the wages.

fact-inquiry-offer.statement: Arlen offers to help ask cautious questions in daylight, without promising accusations, trespass or further cellar work.

fact-next-plan.statement: All three travelers agree to make cautious inquiries in daylight about Iven's account of Dain and North Sluice Repairs.

fact-daylight-lantern-lane.statement: The next morning, all three travelers are together outside the Crooked Lantern on a muddy lane; the rain has eased to drizzle.

fact-visible-stone-bridge.statement: The lane outside the Crooked Lantern leads toward a visible stone bridge a short walk away, with water audible beneath its arch.

fact-notice-poster-present.statement: A person wearing a patched gray coat has just posted the repair notice beside the tavern and greets the travelers.

rumor-s2-t2-poster-dain-unknown.statement: The gray-coated notice poster says they do not know Dain by that name and offers no sighting or information about his whereabouts.

fact-s2-t4-party-reached-bridge.statement: All three travelers walked together from the Crooked Lantern along the muddy lane and reached the near end of the stone bridge without difficulty.

fact-s2-t4-sella-present.statement: Sella is at the near end of the stone bridge beneath a small canvas awning. She introduces herself and asks whether the travelers are here about the repairs.

fact-s2-t4-closed-ledger.statement: A closed ledger rests on a board before Sella at the bridge; its contents have not been seen.

fact-s2-t5-ledger-dain-entry.statement: Sella opens the ledger for all three travelers to see. Under yesterday's date is the entry: “Dain — morning — sluice clearing.” The entry alone does not establish that this is the Dain the travelers seek.

rumor-s2-t5-sella-dain-report.statement: Sella says she entered the name Dain when someone using that name reported for yesterday's morning shift. She requests a description to determine whether he is the person sought and says the entry records neither his departure nor subsequent whereabouts.

She acknowledges wet-ground footing risk.

fact-s2-t7-elara-begins-sorting.statement: Elara accepts Sella’s stated two-silver stone-sorting terms and begins sorting manageable loose stones on the near bank, separating cracked pieces and leaving heavy stones untouched. fact-s2-t8-ledger-permission.statement: Sella gives Torren permission to pause sorting and inspect the open ledger entry for supervisor or assignment notation. Torren has not yet performed that examination.

prior_public_log.speech: Mara! Your guest is coming up. He'll need clean cloth. And nobody else goes down until the water drops.
prior_public_log.action: Torren follows Iven to the upper steps with his recovered staff and calls to Mara for help.
prior_public_log.text: Mara appears at the top with folded linen. 'Iven?' She sets the cloth on the floor and reaches to steady him with both hands. Seeing the water on their clothes, she moves a chair away from the door to clear their path.

prior_public_log.speech: A bell that rings because somebody needs help. I can invoice that as an investigation. The plumbing is beyond our qualifications.
prior_public_log.action: Arlen climbs back to the others, makes sure nobody remains below, and lets Mara know the satchel was lost.
prior_public_log.text: All three travelers and Iven reach the tavern floor. Mara closes the cellar door and draws a bench across it. Iven sits beside the counter, his empty good hand resting on his knee. The bell is silent below them.

The four sit near the counter while Mara wraps Iven's hand in clean linen. Rain still brushes the shutters. The cellar remains flooded behind its blocked door, and the lost receipts remain lost. Mara places a pot of hot broth on the table. 'You found out what was ringing. Supper and beds, as promised.'

prior_public_log.speech: Thank you for the food. But next time, tell us someone might be down there. Why were you hiding him?
prior_public_log.action: Elara asks Mara directly about sheltering Iven while leaving him space to answer for himself.
prior_public_log.text: 'He asked for somewhere nobody would think to look,' Mara says. 'I gave him a dry corner. It was dry then. I didn't want strangers asking whose papers he had.' Iven nods. 'My request. Her mistake was thinking I left. Mine was trying to mend the drain alone.' Neither offers proof of who, if anyone, is looking for him.

prior_public_log.speech: I can write down what you remember. That won't replace the receipts. Your brother's name first, and the place printed on them. I'll mark this as your account, not proof.
prior_public_log.action: Torren opens his notebook and asks Iven for the exact names he remembers, distinguishing recollection from verified evidence.
prior_public_log.text: 'Dain,' Iven says. 'My brother is Dain. The heading was North Sluice Repairs. Seven days ago, wages collected beside his name. I didn't see him sign it. I don't know who did.' He stares at the page. 'I know how little that is without the paper.' Neither Mara nor anyone at the table can corroborate the receipt.

prior_public_log.speech: We can ask about a man and a worksite tomorrow. That isn't a promise to accuse anyone, break into anything, or wade through another cellar. And if it becomes a job, we agree the price before the drowning.
prior_public_log.action: Arlen accepts Mara's supper and offers to help make cautious inquiries in the morning, with explicit limits.
prior_public_log.text: Iven gives a tired nod. 'Questions would be more than I had this morning.' Mara puts bread beside the broth. 'Ask in daylight,' she says. 'The drain can wait for someone with a proper brace.' No fee or route has yet been agreed.

prior_public_log.speech: Questions first. I want to know whether Dain needs help. Tonight we keep Iven warm and make sure nobody goes past that bench.
prior_public_log.action: Elara agrees to the morning inquiries, checks that Iven has a seat near the warmth, and leaves the cellar barrier in place.
prior_public_log.text: Mara brings another dry cloth for Iven's hand. He has stopped shivering by the time the broth cools enough to drink. The bench stays across the cellar door. Beyond the shutters, rain conceals whatever roads and settlements lie outside.

prior_public_log.speech: Dain. North Sluice Repairs. Claimed wages, not confirmed wages. Those are our questions. The rest can remain blank until morning.
prior_public_log.action: Torren reads back the distinctions in his notes, agrees to cautious inquiries at dawn, and closes the notebook for the night.
prior_public_log.text: Iven corrects nothing in the account. Mara lights the way to the promised beds. For tonight, the travelers have a rescued man, an unfixed flood, and two names written above a great deal of blank paper. The world beyond the tavern has not yet answered them.

Morning opens outside the Crooked Lantern, with all three travelers together at its doorway. The rain has eased to a fine drizzle. A muddy lane runs between low buildings toward a stone bridge visible a short walk away; water can be heard beneath its arch.

Beside the tavern entrance, a person in a patched gray coat presses a fresh notice onto a wooden board. Its large lettering reads: “NORTH SLUICE REPAIRS — ENQUIRIES AT THE BRIDGE.” The person steps back to check that the paper holds, then notices the travelers. “Morning.”

The familiar heading is plainly visible. Whether it leads to anyone who knows Dain remains unanswered.

prior_public_log.speech: Morning. Who should we ask for at the bridge? And are these repairs hiring? I like to learn what a job involves before discovering it waist-deep.
prior_public_log.action: Arlen remains beside his companions and gestures toward the notice, asking the gray-coated person about the contact and the work.
prior_public_log.text:
The notice poster smooths a curling corner of the paper. “Ask for Sella at the bridge. She handles the repair enquiries and takes names for work.”

At Arlen’s mention of water, the poster gives a brief nod. “They’re looking for hands to carry stone and clear debris. That’s what I was told to advertise. Sella can tell you which tasks are on dry ground and what each pays. I only agreed to put up the notices.”

The poster remains beside the board, leaving room for another question.

prior_public_log.speech: Thank you. One more question: do you know a man named Dain? His brother hasn't heard from him in a month. We're trying to find out whether he needs help.
prior_public_log.action: Elara stays beside her companions and asks the notice poster about Dain, keeping her hands relaxed at her sides.
prior_public_log.text:
The notice poster turns from the board to Elara. “I don't know him by that name. I'm sorry—you've more reason to ask than someone looking for a day's wages.”

They glance toward the bridge. “Ask Sella whether he worked on the repairs. I can't say whether she knows him, but she handles the work enquiries. I wouldn't want to send you off thinking I'd seen him.”

The poster remains beside the notice. The bridge is still visible through the drizzle.

prior_public_log.speech: Thank you for being precise. Let's ask Sella whether Dain worked there, and what records might establish when. One question at a time.
prior_public_log.action: Torren nods to the notice poster, then gestures toward the bridge and offers to walk there with his companions, keeping his staff ready for the muddy footing.
prior_public_log.text:
“You're welcome,” the notice poster replies, stepping aside to leave the lane clear.

The short approach to the bridge is muddy but passable, with no barrier across it. Torren's invitation leaves the three companions together beside the notice, with the way onward open.
